sources.note: Main website. Describes Canvas as AI-powered healthcare platform for clinics. Lists specialty EMR offerings (primary care, behavioral health, cardiology, weight loss, etc.), AI agents (Hyperscribe, Claim Coding, Parsing), and key features including Narrative Charting, FHIR API, SDK, scheduling, billing.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Describes Canvas Medical 1 as certified Health IT Module. Lists CPOE, drug interaction screening, demographics, family health history, implantable device tracking, transitions of care, e-prescribing, clinical quality measures, immunization registry reporting, APIs. Subscription-based pricing.

About page. Founded 2015 by Andrew Hines. CEO Adam Farren (Sept 2024). Key milestones: first clinic 2018, developer tools 2021, ONC certification 2022, open-source patient app 2024. Nine major investors listed.

Announces self-serve EMR and payments platform. Describes Narrative Charting (3x faster), bidirectional FHIR endpoints for scheduling/eligibility/claims, Workflow SDK for custom clinical/operational/financial workflows, Developer Dashboard, direct-to-consumer and fee-for-service payment models.

Series B announcement ($24M). Describes EMR with scheduling, data exchange, patient engagement, revenue cycle management. Customers include Patina Health, Circulo, Vivante Health, Isaac Health. 300% customer base growth.

Developer docs homepage. Platform supports 40 FHIR resources (21 writable), SDK with 650+ events, handlers, effects, and pre-built integration clients. Four main sections: API, SDK, Guides, Product Updates.

Complete FHIR API reference. Lists all supported resources: AllergyIntolerance, Appointment, CarePlan, CareTeam, Claim, Communication, Condition, Consent, Coverage, CoverageEligibilityRequest/Response, DetectedIssue, Device, DiagnosticReport, DocumentReference, Encounter, Goal, Group, Immunization, Location, Media, Medication, MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, MedicationStatement, Observation, Organization, Patient, PaymentNotice, Practitioner, Procedure, Provenance, Questionnaire, QuestionnaireResponse, RelatedPerson, Schedule, Slot, Specimen, Task. Plus custom APIs: CCDA, Letter, Note.

SDK data model reference. Lists 47+ data models including clinical (AllergyIntolerance, Condition, Medication, Labs, Imaging, Observation, Device, Immunization), administrative (Appointment, Encounter, Note, Staff, CanvasUser, Organization, Facility, Calendar, Task), financial (BillingLineItem, ChargeDescriptionMaster, PayorSpecificCharge, Claim, Posting, Coverage, EligibilitySummary), communication (Message, Letter, Questionnaire), and specialized models (Command, Protocol, ExternalEvent, BusinessLine).

Architecture overview. Describes plugin runner (open-source gRPC server), three core concepts: Events (650+ clinical/operational triggers), Data (read-only Django ORM views of 47+ models), Effects (typed instruction payloads). Handler types: BaseHandler, CronTask, ActionButton, SimpleAPI, Application.

2026 Best in KLAS Ambulatory Specialty EHR award. Describes customizable API-first system, prebuilt plugin library, task management for nurses/CHWs. Specialties: cardiology, behavioral health, psychiatry, GI, chronic care, cardiometabolic, longevity, primary care, urgent care. User feedback highlights flexibility and adaptability to value-based care.
TechCrunch Series B coverage. Describes Canvas as 'the Tesla of EMRs'. $24M Series B led by M13. Total funding ~$64.4M. Founded 2015, targets digital health companies and specialty practices.
KLAS 2025 Emerging Company Spotlight report page. Highlights Canvas bridging workflow gaps through customization. Confirms robust API and adaptability to non-fee-for-service models.
SourceForge product listing. No user reviews posted yet as of research date. All ratings at 0.0/5 with no reviews.
Fierce Healthcare coverage of Hyperscribe launch — Canvas's open-source AI clinical documentation copilot.
